name: Carozzi S.A.
summary: Carozzi S.A. engages in production, marketing, distribution, import, and export of food products in Chile. It offers Olive oil, rice, flours and premixes, jams, pasta, sauces and tomato pastes, compotes, preserves, fruit and vegetable pulps, cereals and oats, liquid beverages, powdered beverages, coffee, ethnic food, desserts, cookies, chocolates, candies, ice cream, cereal bars, sponge cakes, alfajores, panettone, popcorn, nuts, pet food, and home hygiene products for pets. The company markets its products under the Ambrosoli, Carozzi, Costa, Molitalia, Master Dog, Selecta, Master Cat, Mimaskot, Fanny, Vivo, Tres Ositos, Parma, Pancho Villa, Nik, Frugelé, Frac, Vizzio, Carezza, Rolls, Natur…
